Class MenuPage

java.lang.Object
Manager.Page
MenuPage
public class MenuPage extends Manager.Page
Provides the menu management page for the Sharetea POS manager interface. Supports viewing, adding, and editing menu items and their ingredient recipes.
Author:
Kevin Li

  • Constructor Details

    • MenuPage

      public MenuPage(Manager manager)

  • Method Details

    • show

      public void show()
      Displays the menu table and buttons for adding items, editing items, and editing recipes, then loads the current menu data.
      Specified by:
      show in class Manager.Page

    • loadMenuItems

      private void loadMenuItems()
      Loads all menu items from the database into the shared table. Displays availability values as checkboxes and reports database errors.

    • addMenuItem

      private void addMenuItem()
      Prompts for a new menu item and its recipe, then saves both within a single database transaction. Cancelling either dialog saves nothing.

    • editMenuItem

      private void editMenuItem()
      Opens an edit form for the selected menu item and saves validated changes. Warns the user if no menu item is selected.

    • editRecipe

      private void editRecipe()
      Loads and edits the selected menu item's ingredient recipe. Replaces the saved recipe within a database transaction.

    • showMenuItemForm

      private MenuPage.MenuItemValues showMenuItemForm(String title, String name, String price, String category, boolean available)
      Displays a menu item form prefilled with the supplied values and validates its name, category, and non-negative price.
      Parameters:
      title - the dialog title
      name - the initial item name
      price - the initial price as text
      category - the initial item category
      available - the initial availability setting
      Returns:
      validated menu item values, or null if cancelled or invalid

    • chooseRecipe

      private Map<Integer,Double> chooseRecipe(String menuItemName, Map<Integer,Double> current)
      Displays an editable recipe table containing all inventory items. New recipes initially include one of each default supply item.
      Parameters:
      menuItemName - the name displayed in the recipe dialog
      current - existing ingredient amounts keyed by inventory item ID, or null when creating a new recipe
      Returns:
      selected positive ingredient amounts keyed by inventory item ID, or null if cancelled or inventory loading fails

    • readRecipe

      private Map<Integer,Double> readRecipe(DefaultTableModel model)
      Reads and validates ingredient quantities from the recipe table. Blank and zero quantities are omitted; invalid amounts trigger a warning.
      Parameters:
      model - the table model containing ingredient quantities
      Returns:
      a map of positive amounts keyed by inventory item ID, or null if an amount is invalid

    • saveRecipe

      private void saveRecipe(int menuItemId, Map<Integer,Double> recipe) throws SQLException
      Inserts ingredient rows for a menu item into MenuItemIngredient. The caller is responsible for managing the database transaction.
      Parameters:
      menuItemId - the ID of the menu item whose recipe is saved
      recipe - ingredient quantities keyed by inventory item ID
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database operation fails

    • setMenuItemValues

      private static void setMenuItemValues(PreparedStatement statement, MenuPage.MenuItemValues item, int firstIndex) throws SQLException
      Binds a menu item's name, price, category, and availability to four consecutive parameters of a prepared SQL statement.
      Parameters:
      statement - the prepared statement to populate
      item - the validated menu item values
      firstIndex - the one-based index of the first SQL parameter
      Throws:
      SQLException - if binding a parameter fails
